caption: The video captures a large, already-developed fireball burning beneath a pale overcast sky. A low dirt berm with a fence line runs across the foreground, and at right a utility pole with a street lamp stands beside a gray electrical cabinet. The central mass shows bright orange-yellow flames embedded in a cauliflower-like dark smoke cloud, topped by a rising orange plume. Throughout, the luminous core drifts upward within the dark smoke as the column expands and the plume grows taller and more diffuse. The fireball's internal bright patches flicker in intensity rather than holding a steady glow. To the left a separate grayish-brown smoke cloud broadens and softens, while to the right a thin orange arcing streak stays roughly constant. The pole, lamp and cabinet stay fixed in the scene, but the camera drifts and shakes, shifting their positions and blurring some frames. No ignition or extinguishing appears, so the combustion continues in its ongoing state.
relations: Luminous core drifts upward within dark smoke as the column expands and the orange plume grows taller and diffuse.
Bright internal patches flicker in intensity rather than holding a steady glow while combustion continues.
Left grayish-brown smoke broadens and softens while a right orange arcing streak stays roughly constant.
Pole, lamp and cabinet remain fixed as the camera drifts and shakes, shifting their positions and blurring frames.
